candidate.title: Admin group add/remove member actions drop the AJAX promise, making failures silent and leaving stale UI state
reports: app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:56 — the remove action discards the delete promise, so failed removals are unhandled and the admin receives no indication that membership was unchanged.

app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:47 — both mutation methods detach the follow-up findmembers promise, so a successful write followed by a failed reload resolves as success and leaves stale membership state.

[low/bug] app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js (addmembers) — no error handling on the ajax call; a 422 response (e.g. automatic group) leaves the promise rejection unhandled and the admin gets no ui feedback. same for removemember

[bug] addmembers has the same defect: the .then calls self.findmembers() without returning it, detaching the reload's failure from the promise chain. after a successful add, a failed refresh leaves the newly added member invisible in the list with no error, so the admin cannot tell whether the add took effect.
